steps.name: add-shared-dual-ble-scanner
steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "c3f60834e592ded5b84072e9355dfa7daad95c5a"
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path("src/CMakeLists.txt")
s = p.read_text()
needle = '      "climate/native/BleClimateState.cpp"\n'
assert needle in s and '"climate/native/BleClimateScanner.cpp"' not in s
p.write_text(s.replace(needle, needle + '      "climate/native/BleClimateScanner.cpp"\n', 1))
PY
.venv/bin/pre-commit run clang-format --files src/climate/native/BleClimateScanner.h src/climate/native/BleClimateScanner.cpp || true
.venv/bin/pre-commit run --files src/climate/native/BleClimateScanner.h src/climate/native/BleClimateScanner.cpp src/CMakeLists.txt
git diff --check

verify_steps.name: focused-scanner-build
verify_steps.command: set -euo pipefail; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "c3f60834e592ded5b84072e9355dfa7daad95c5a"; git diff --check; bash scripts/stage27c_crowpanel.sh build

verify_steps.name: full-scanner-gate-and-publish
verify_steps.command: set -euo pipefail; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "c3f60834e592ded5b84072e9355dfa7daad95c5a"; .venv/bin/pre-commit run --all-files; cmake -S test/host -B build/host-tests; cmake --build build/host-tests --parallel; ctest --test-dir build/host-tests --output-on-failure; bash scripts/stage27c_crowpanel.sh clean; bash scripts/stage27c_crowpanel.sh build; git diff --check; git add src/climate/native/BleClimateScanner.h src/climate/native/BleClimateScanner.cpp src/CMakeLists.txt; git commit -m 'Add shared Stage27C dual BLE scanner'; git push origin HEAD:mvp/environment-controller; test -z "$(git status --short)"; git rev-parse HEAD
